terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws", version = "~> 5.0" }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region                      = "eu-west-2"
  skip_credentials_validation = true
  skip_requesting_account_id  = true
  skip_metadata_api_check     = true
}

variable "gen" {
  type    = string
  default = "v1"
}

resource "terraform_data" "dep" {
  input = var.gen
}

resource "terraform_data" "fresh" {
  triggers_replace = var.gen
  input            = "x"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "created_doc" {
  statement {
    sid       = "CreatedStatement"
    actions   = ["sqs:SendMessage"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-2:ACCOUNT-PLACEHOLDER:literal", terraform_data.fresh.id]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "dynamic_unknown_doc" {
  dynamic "statement" {
    for_each = split(",", terraform_data.dep.output)
    content {
      sid       = "Dyn${statement.value}"
      actions   = ["sqs:ReceiveMessage"]
      resources = ["*"]
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "inner_unrendered_doc" {
  dynamic "statement" {
    for_each = split(",", terraform_data.dep.output)
    content {
      sid       = "Inner${statement.value}"
      actions   = ["sns:Publish"]
      resources = ["*"]
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "chained_doc" {
  source_policy_documents = [data.aws_iam_policy_document.inner_unrendered_doc.json]

  statement {
    sid       = "ChainedStatement"
    actions   = ["sns:Subscribe"]
    resources = [terraform_data.dep.id]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "overridden_doc" {
  override_policy_documents = [data.aws_iam_policy_document.base_doc.json]

  statement {
    sid       = "OverrideStatement"
    actions   = ["kms:Decrypt"]
    resources = [terraform_data.dep.id]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "base_doc" {
  statement {
    sid       = "BaseStatement"
    actions   = ["kms:Encrypt"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "transformed_doc" {
  statement {
    sid       = "TransformedStatement"
    actions   = ["ssm:GetParameter"]
    resources = [terraform_data.dep.id]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "created_policy" {
  name   = "created_policy"
  role   = "role-placeholder"
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.created_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "dynamic_unknown_policy" {
  name   = "dynamic_unknown_policy"
  role   = "role-placeholder"
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.dynamic_unknown_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "chained_policy" {
  name   = "chained_policy"
  role   = "role-placeholder"
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.chained_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "overridden_policy" {
  name   = "overridden_policy"
  role   = "role-placeholder"
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.overridden_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "transformed_policy" {
  name   = "transformed_policy"
  role   = "role-placeholder"
  policy = replace(data.aws_iam_policy_document.transformed_doc.json, "ssm:GetParameter", "ssm:GetParameters")
}
